name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer earning a 50% interest in the Lapon Canyon Gold Project located in the Walker Lane gold trend of Nevada, approximately 40 miles southeast of Yerington. The company holds a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and is spending toward a $5M Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement with Walker River Resources. A maiden NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate is targeted for 2026.
